external_sources.title: Appliance Health Monitoring for Memory, CPU and Disk performance
external_sources.content:
Each of these numbers is in kilobytes. The main thing to look for is “free”. This number must be above 256,000 for EdgeConnect to be considered healthy. This number can go as low as 50,000, and EdgeConnect will still function normally, but as a best practice is to alarm at 256,000. For example, if you were monitoring memory usage, the best metric to use is “free," which is the available memory. If the memory goes below 50,000 KB, one needs to investigate the gateway and check for its health in [...] If either of these conditions is not met, It does not necessarily mean that the appliance is degraded or will misbehave, but rather, provides an indicator that someone should look at the system to further evaluate the health of the memory. The EdgeConnect software is designed to maintain relatively constant memory consumption – looking at memory trends on Orchestrator will help identify scenarios where memory consumption is increasing over time. If the swap space is impacting the performance of [...] The appliance supports a REST API to retrieve Disk usage statistics. This can be accessed through the appliance, using the following API:

GET /diskUsage

### Getting disk usage statistics

GET /rest/json/diskUsage
